conviction_note: The H1 operating miss was pre-released on 2026-09-29 and the stock did not move on it (-0.1%). The full-year plan was explicitly held one month ago by a company that has guided low and revised up repeatedly, and a new 6.33% value holder has been buying through a thin tape that has sat at 4,900-5,050 since the August buyback. So the lean is a mild positive. The one real downside is a full-year cut at this release, which the company's own 9/29 wording argues against. Findings sum +0.6; scaled +0.35 (p_up 55 x abs 3.5). They agree in sign, and the scaled number is smaller because it carries the FY-cut tail in p_up.
bar: Company's own revised H1 forecast of 2026-09-29: sales 14,300m, OP -200m, ordinary -200m, NP 110m. The full-year plan was held at sales 40,200m / OP 1,600m / ordinary 1,550m / NP 2,550m / dividend 80 (20 interim + 60 year-end). Source https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260929/140120260929541978.pdf. There is no IFIS consensus (kabuyoho shows '--', https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=6822) and no 四季報 number could be reached, so the bar is the company plan alone.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0%, unchanged, no disclosed seller (as of 2026-10-28, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). kabutan lists the name as 制度信用 buy-only (no margin shorting) with 信用倍率 '－' (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6822). There is no options market, so no skew. On the long side, キャピタル・マネジメント filed a new 5% report on 2026-10-27: 6.33%, 93,000 shares, obligation date 10/20 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6822&b=n202610270901). There is no short fuel and no crowded short.

findings.finding: The H1 that reports today was pre-released on 2026-09-29 (OP cut from +200m to -200m, sales from 15,800m to 14,300m). On 9/30 the stock closed -0.1% on 16,300 shares, so the operating miss that drove this name's last two print reactions (-15.1% after the 2025-10-30 H1, -10.1% after the 2026-07-29 Q1, both unannounced) is already in the price. This company has also tended to land at or above its own revised numbers (FY3/26 OP 1,771m against a 2026-02 guide of 1,500m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline: -15.1% after the 2025-10-30 H1 (2Q ordinary -34%, not pre-announced) and -10.09% on 2026-07-30 after a Q1 loss that was not pre-announced. 9/30/2026 pre-release reaction: -0.1% (Yahoo daily bars).
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced, and that is the point. A pre-released miss that did not move the stock leaves no seller for the confirmation. If holders had not yet absorbed it, the 9/30 bar would show a gap down rather than a 4,895 low and a 4,995 close. What is left is a small chance that H1 lands above the 9/29 numbers, based on the company's record of beating its own revised guides (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260515/140120260515538397.pdf).
findings.independence: Daily bars, a separate source: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/6822.T?range=6mo&interval=1d shows 9/29 at 5,000 and 9/30 at 4,995.

findings.finding: The full-year plan (OP 1,600m) was explicitly held on 9/29, yet it now implies H2 OP of about 1,800m against 1,545m in the prior-year H2 (Q3 526m + Q4 1,019m) and H2 sales of 25,900m (+24% y/y). The company itself blames rising raw-material costs on 2nd-generation smart-meter devices for the margin damage, so a full-year cut at this release is the one item that could add new bad news.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On guidance this name has mostly revised up: FY3/25 was raised at the H1 print (2024-10-30, ordinary +38%), at Q3 (2025-02-12, stop-high) and in April 2025 (+31%). FY3/26 actual beat the Feb guide by 18% at OP. The archive shows no full-year cut since FY3/22. Source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6822
findings.why_not_priced: The pinned price (4,900-5,050 since August) reads as holders accepting the hold. If a cut were expected, the stock would have drifted below the 4,950 buyback price after 9/29, and it has not. The residual is a tail, which is why this is sized small: the company reaffirmed one month ago with a stated reason (smart-meter margin measures, slipped optical sales booking in H2), and this issuer's record is to revise up.
findings.independence: The H2-required arithmetic rests on the kabutan quarterly table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6822) and the 9/29 notice. Both describe the same company plan, so treat them as one source.

findings.finding: A new holder, キャピタル・マネジメント, crossed 5% at 6.33% (93,000 shares, obligation date 2026-10-20, filed 10/27). That is about 20 days of this stock's ~4-5k-share daily volume. The same filer took 大木ヘルスケア from 5.01% to 9.95% between May and August 2026, so it adds after crossing. Combined with the company's August ToSTNeT-3 buyback of 173,800 shares at 4,950, the thin float has a demonstrated buyer under it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 10/27 filing the stock rose +0.9% (10/27, on 300 shares) and +1.19% (10/28). After the 8/18 buyback announcement it rose +5.86% on 8/19. Bars: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/6822.T?range=6mo&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: The filing itself is priced (+2.1% over two sessions). What is not in a level is the asymmetry it creates on a release day: on a weak headline (kabutan will print 'H1 ordinary swings to a loss') an accumulating holder absorbs the sellers who drove the -15% and -10% gaps before. If the market treated the bid as gone, the stock would not be holding 5,100 into a print whose quarter is a loss.
findings.independence: Same filer adding in another name: https://finance.matsui.co.jp/news/608531/index. The company buyback is a separate fact: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6822&b=n202608190284

findings.finding: The 2026-05-15 mid-term plan names a stock split as under consideration (the 100-share unit is ~¥510k, above TSE's ¥500k guideline) and commits to progressive dividends from the FY3/25 base. Japanese issuers often announce splits in the same TDnet batch as results, so a split at this print is a possible positive, though nothing says it is coming.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No split history for this name. The last capital-return surprise, the 8/18 buyback, bought +5.86% the next day.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody can price a split's timing. The plan's wording is public, but nothing suggests a split this quarter, so it is sized as a low-probability positive. The return budget (3-10億 over three years) was largely spent on the 8.66億 August buyback, so a further buyback is unlikely, and that is not sized.

outside_window.finding: Mitsubishi Electric still holds 4.99% after selling into the August buyback. A further exit is a later overhang with no date.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: the full year was held 30 days ago; a cut at this print is a tail (~15-20%), not the base case, and there is no street number to beat. Returns: interim 20 as planned, a split possible but unsignalled, a buyback unlikely so soon after August. New-year guide: n/a (H1 print). Quarter: H1 pre-released to the 9/29 numbers, Q2 standalone OP near zero against +202m a year earlier. This is a seasonal name whose profit sits in Q4, so H1 progress (-12.5% of FY OP) compares with +14% a year earlier, a gap that is public.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Further own-share buyback at this print
rejected_candidates.detail: The mid-term plan caps capital policy at 3-10億 over FY2026-28 and the August ToSTNeT-3 used 8.66億 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6822&b=n202608190360), so a new buyback now runs against the stated allocation

baseline_tension: The findings agree with the flat baseline lean (-0.1, run-up +2.0%): there are no shorts and no margin overhang, and the one positioning fact (a new 6.33% buyer) is long-side. Strongest positive the release could carry: a held full-year plan plus an H1 slightly above the 9/29 numbers, or a split. I looked for both, and neither is pre-signalled beyond the plan's wording. Strongest negative: a full-year cut, sized as a tail.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (negatives on public series toward 50) does not bite because the one negative rests on what the release could ADD (a FY cut), and it is already sized as a tail. Rule 2 was checked: one negative against three positives, with the strongest positive written in baseline_tension. Open question 3 (a pre-released H1 tends to kill the event) is consistent with the draft's abs_move cut from the 5.13 proxy to 3.5, and as a single case it was not applied again.
